scope: Two owner-authorised real A1 sprinkler PDFs retrieved from connected quoting storage. Original files, identifiers, labels, crops and workbooks remain ignored/local; this record contains anonymised measurements only.
permission: Owner explicitly instructed use of relevant Dropbox quoting drawings for local benchmark. No customer drawing uploaded to GitHub or Countfire.

implemented.feature: Bounded fixed-resolution tiled raster counting and saved recount for pages exceeding the existing4Mpixel canvas limit.
implemented.compatibility: Same2x native pixel grid and saved algorithm/data formats; existing smallpage path unchanged. Source crop uses integer pixel offsets; deterministic half-open tile ownership, cancellation atomic.
implemented.canvasLifecycle: Scratch backing is explicitly released after copying ImageData or on failure.

baseline: Whole-page renderer rejects16.06Mpixels against4Mlimit before matching. Baseline accuracy undefined, not0%.

groundTruth.reviewer: Independent QA agent manual visual inspection before seeing matcher output; provisional AI review, not human estimator verification
groundTruth.scope: Two declared main-plan ROIs, red-filled circular geometry family with black outer border and central diamond. Other red/architectural symbols excluded by geometry.
groundTruth.semanticLimits: Sameproject legend independently inspected: round family is new pendant sprinkler, quartered disk is concealed-space sprinkler, triangle is side-wall sprinkler. Lift-top special subtype still needs separate classification.

applicationChrome.divergence: Firstsheet anchors/scores identical to Node; second-sheet Node hit absent in Chrome. Cause not established; do not present Node5/19 as application accuracy.

performance.interpretation: Single runs, host load varies. RSS spans PDF.js/canvas caches and three serial in-process searches, not isolated per-run or browser memory.4Mtile limit does not prove acceptable total memory. No p50/p95/task-time claim.

independentIntegrity.input: Two original PDFs and5 actual Node detections in isolated private store
independentIntegrity.manualCorrections: One deliberate reviewed exclusion plus14 manually added misses (test decisions, not measured estimator actions)
verified: Rerun preserves IDs, exclusions, manual additions, reviews, colours and zones

rejectedExperiment.blockingNegativeControl: Small internal dot shifted by one pixel is incorrectly accepted while strict matcher rejects it. Quartered-symbol false positives independently inspected.
rejectedExperiment.status: Not shipped; scratch only. Exploratory tuned corpus results, not holdout validation.

Whole-page clipped/form/image content still falls back to raster; do not ignore clipping
Large-page element editing and retained glyph colouring retain their separate4Mlimits; outline count colours remain

historicalReconciliation.status: Independently checked private legend and archived quantity workbook
historicalReconciliation.interpretation: Archived relevant quantity cells agree with frozen round-family totals when lift subtype is included. Historical corrections/automatic contribution unknown; no vendor automatic-accuracy claim. Frozen instance labels unchanged. Concealed-space historical quantities9/11 differ from observed ROI marks and are outside this benchmark; do not claim overall workbook completeness.
historicalReconciliation.limitations: Comparisons use literal per-drawing quantity cells. Workbook SUM cells have cached zero values; no recalculation observed. Source filenames/revisions correspond, but archived source PDF byte identity and historical automatic/manual contributions are unverified.

tileMemoryFollowup.implementation: Yield to a zero-delay timer after each completed tile, then check cancellation and deadline before allocating the next tile. No matcher/data-format change.
tileMemoryFollowup.limitations: Single Node fixture; browser memory and long-duration leak behavior unmeasured. Browser workers already yield. Exact native allocator attribution unproven. Diagnostic GC was performed only after searches.

validation.timerCancellation: New test confirms cancellation delivered by a real timer prevents next-tile allocation.

tileMemoryFollowup.recognitionGuard: Original hard-pixel fixture: strict matcher finds two true symbols and rejects shifted internal dots and missing detail. New appearance candidate remains unintegrated pending independent controls and browser evidence.

appearanceExperiment.status: Integrated explicit new-selection opt-in; local194tests,67ownedbrowserchecks,8realUIchecks and independent actual-instance Excel reconciliation passed.
appearanceExperiment.method: Retained RGB, one global fractional-pixel translation and quarter-turn orientation, symmetric isolated contrast-detail checks. Every strict proposal is verified; no blind union.

independentControls.remainingMiss: Black diagonal stroke occludes internal detail.

v3FirstUnseenNode.limitation: Labels frozen before candidate output. Reviewer had previously seen an archived aggregate; not fully blinded to historical total. Later versions use this drawing as regression data, not unseen validation.

v4DevelopmentNode.selectionFix: Keep passing strict orientation; otherwise choose lowest-RMSE orientation among those passing all unchanged gates. Original generated orientation counterexample added.

remainingGates: Fresh representative holdout and human-estimator labels
Occluded internal detail and unsafe clip/form geometry
Largepage element selection and retained-glyph colouring

moduleInChrome.scope: Module benchmark in isolated Chrome using actual PDF.js RGBA and fixed tiles; not application UI acceptance. Third drawing now regression, not unseen.
